finding: P37A blocked write/ref commands when commit_push_authorized=false, but did not fully remove the implementation sub-agent habit of owning the phase commit/push boundary.

finding: Sub-agent packets could still omit the parent commit boundary wording and treat commit/push as implicit completion behavior.

finding: Review could inspect files/state and miss that the sub-agent notification itself claimed unauthorized commit/push/directives.
fix: Updated plan-review-SKILL.md, phase-completion-packager-SKILL.md, implementation-integrity-SKILL.md, and generated-code-review-SKILL.md to require notification inspection and reject bundled artifact+commit authority.

finding: P38 needed two separate statuses: useful artifact after independent validation, and process violation requiring governance repair.
fix: Recorded P38 as accepted only after independent validation, with unauthorized commit/push overrun repaired by P38A; added session-constitution rule that such agents are disqualified from further write work in the phase family until parent repair.
